about_the_game:
Inner Voice is a first-person horror-adventure exploration game, featuring atmospheric storytelling and occasional story puzzles. Get ready to explore a surreal world shrouded in mystery, as the enigmatic voice of Magnus White guides you toward your final chapter.

STORY

You play as Booker, a hunted man who lost his wife, Diana, searching for answers in a place abandoned by time and sanity, buried in silence and pain.

As the voice of Magnus White echoes through the darkness, the mysteries of this haunting world begin to unravel before you.

Get ready to explore the twisted remnants of a once-living world... but be careful!
With no combat, no allies and only your instincts to rely on, every step could be your last.

GAME FEATURES

Exploration-Driven Levels & Auto-Saving

Experience 4 unique chapters that blend linear storytelling with open-world exploration. Fully explorable buildings encourage careful inspection and help players uncover more secrets. Progress is automatically saved at the start of each Chapter. The Chapters stay unlocked but each chapter's playthrough always starts anew.

Story-Integrated Puzzles

Solve puzzles embedded in the environment and narrative to unlock deeper truths about the world and your character.

Immersive Audio & Visuals

Fully voice-acted, with an original soundtrack and high end visuals that create a tense, atmospheric horror experience.

Multiple Endings

Discover 3 story endings plus 1 hidden secret ending based on player's choices, encouraging replayability and exploration of alternate choices.

Unique Setting

A haunted Victorian/Western world, blending reality with fiction, designed to immerse you into a chilling, surreal narrative experience.

Developer's Note

This is a Solo Developed game.
For the best possible experience, take your time.
Explore each environment carefully, listen closely and let the atmosphere guide you.

The truth lies in the details.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature themes, including scenes depicting self-harm and psychological distress. Player discretion is advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This game is optimized for mid-to-high-end systems. Lower specs may experience reduced performance or visual quality.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Super (8 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 16 GB available space

short_description: Step into the world of "Inner Voice", where the silence is louder than screams. In this atmospheric horror experience you will uncover long-buried secrets as the story unfolds. Every creak and every whisper holds a part of this story. Are you ready to face this nightmare?
